description.value: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
Creatures within 60 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't regain Hit Points.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has a magical gem. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed while the gem is on the same plane of existence as it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} gains a new body in 1d20 days, regaining all its Hit Points and appearing within 5 feet of the gem. The gem is a Tiny object that has AC 20; HP 50; and Immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. The gem regains all its Hit Points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the gem is destroyed, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can create a new one by completing an 8-hour ritual using a gem worth 1,000+ GP and by expending 5,000 GP, which the ritual consumes.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .rmNMe5md0XVcdMqe]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item .dz0vQNReKOuEuNgh]] to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofSickn]{Ray of Sickness} (level 2 version).
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=7Mc9LZSWBAIC4BTQ]], each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: [[/damage 8d12 average type=necrotic]] damage. Success: Half damage.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], [[lookup @attributes.spell.attack]] to hit with spell attacks):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofSickn]{Ray of Sickness} (level 2 version)

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCreateUnde]{Create Undead} (level 8 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFingerofDe]{Finger of Death}
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses Spellcasting to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofSickn]{Ray of Sickness} (level 2 version). The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=aKJ7hLdBbuMyU9IM]], each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: [[/damage 2d10 average type=psychic]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
